human_oversight: The manuscript states that human authors reviewed the AI-assisted preparation and retain responsibility.
Author identities, CRediT roles, declarations, and final accountable sign-off are still unfilled author-owned inputs.
transparency: The manuscript discloses manuscript-preparation AI use, provider/model scope, the Gemini stopping rule, incomplete diagnostic status, and the no-cross-provider boundary.
The Methods section distinguishes research-model calls from manuscript-preparation assistance and reports failure handling and ITT denominators.
reproducibility: The current manuscript is linked to frozen task selections, compact raw records, deterministic analyses, six result tables, five figures, and focused builders.
The provider alias limitation and the lack of immutable hidden-weight identifiers are disclosed.
fit_for_purpose: The paired authorization design, policy/full package comparison, failure-sensitive bound, benchmark stratification, and budget-50/200 adaptive analysis directly answer the bounded research questions.
The paper does not use the bundled package contrast for component-level causal attribution.
